author: PackRat 🐀
name: Now Playing Panel
description: A frictionless system media panel for XENEON Edge. It reads the Windows media session through iCUE, so Spotify, Apple Music, VLC and browser players can share one screen without a helper app. Oversized track typography sits over an artist-derived generative gradient, with previous, play or pause and next controls always within reach. Extra Large layouts keep a local recently played list, and idle time becomes an ambient clock instead of a dead panel.
